moc.chu: Herodotus also mentions that the loss of daylight had been predicted by Thales of Miletus.
The Medes and Lydians, when they observed the change, ceased fighting, and were alike anxious to have terms of peace agreed on.
As part of the terms of the peace agreement, Alyattes's daughter Aryenis was married to Cyaxares's son Astyages
If Herodotus's account is accurate, this eclipse is the earliest recorded as being known in advance of its occurrence.
